prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
WD-KIT / Kit: six-year-old human boy, golden light-medium skin, short straight black side-parted hair, teal T-shirt, mustard shorts, navy sneakers. WD-ZOE / Zoe: six-year-old human girl, deep brown skin, black hair in two puffs, yellow T-shirt, plum overalls, white sneakers. Kit and Zoe have equal standing height. Include only characters needed by this exact scene, not every reference pose. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: The Stretchy Bridge; World Discovery; fiction.
Setting: World Discovery classroom play table in afternoon light. A narrow blue cloth river separates two tan cardboard banks; a small red toy garage stands on the far bank with its hinged door facing the river.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): One teal wooden-looking magic toy bridge with low side rails; One yellow four-wheeled toy truck; One red toy garage with hinged door; One fixed blue cloth river and two flat tan cardboard banks
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 4. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): One end blocks Zoe’s toy garage. “Short!” she calls. The bridge slides away from the far bank.
Required illustration: World Discovery classroom play table in afternoon light. A narrow blue cloth river separates two tan cardboard banks; a small red toy garage stands on the far bank with its hinged door facing the river. Zoe gestures toward the blocked red garage door as the bridge shortens; truck is near its withdrawing far end. Exact state: Bridge near end remains fixed; far end pulls back; garage door still shut.
Exact current state: Bridge near end remains fixed; far end pulls back; garage door still shut.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.
Critical geometry: tabletop toys; children stand on FLOOR behind table, only upper bodies and arms above tabletop. The teal bridge has a flat deck, TWO low side rails running along its LONG edges, and OPEN ends for the truck to drive through. Rails never cross the driving path. Same left-to-right layout and only ONE bridge. Show current shorter state: left near end remains resting on left bank; far right end has withdrawn back over the blue cloth, leaving a small gap to right bank. ONE yellow truck is near this bridge's withdrawing far right end, pointing right, not on bank or in garage. Zoe gestures toward CLOSED garage door. No duplicated long bridge or ghost-image motion phases.

visualReview.note: Shortened bridge retains left-bank support while right end withdraws over cloth with truck near it; gap to far bank visible. Zoe gestures to closed garage. No duplicated bridge or truck, rails follow deck.
